definitions.short: Nemuel , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H5241. Nemuel נְמוּאֵל proper name, masculine (compare Gray Prop. N. 307 ); — 1 son of Simeon Num 26:12 ; 1Chr 4:24 (= יְמוּאֵל , q. v., Gen 46:10 ; Exod 6:15 ), ᵐ5 Ναμουηλ . 2 a Reubenite (brother of Dathan and Abiram) Num 26:9 , ᵐ5 id.
